Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad
O Allah, You are the Eternal God
And this is a new year
So I ask You in it for protection from Satan

Arabic text: وَالْقُوَّةَ عَلٰى هٰذِهِ النَّفْسِ الْأَمَّارَةِ بِالسُّوءِ
Translation: And strength against this soul that commands to evil

Arabic text: وَالْإِشْتِغَالَ بِمَا يُقَرِّبُنِيْ إِلَيْكَ يَا كَرِيمُ
Translation: And to be occupied with what brings me closer to You, O Generous One
O Lord of Majesty and Honor

Arabic text: يَا عِمَادَ مَنْ لَا عِمَادَ لَهُ
Translation: O Support of the one who has no support

Arabic text: يَا ذَخِيرَةَ مَنْ لَا ذَخِيرَةَ لَهُ
Translation: O Treasure of the one who has no treasure
O Sanctuary of the one who has no sanctuary
O Helper of the one who has no helper
O Strength of the one who has no strength
O Wealth of the one who has no wealth
O One of beautiful trials
O One of great hope
O Honor of the weak
O Rescuer of the drowning
O Savior of the perishing
O Bestower of blessings, O Beautifier
O Granter of bounties, O Benefactor

Arabic text: أَنْتَ الَّذِيْ سَجَدَ لَكَ سَوَادُ اللَّيْلِ وَنُوْرُ النَّهَارِ
Translation: You are the One to Whom the darkness of night prostrates, and the light of day
And the glow of the moon and the rays of the sun
And the sound of water and the rustling of trees
O Allah, You have no partner
O Allah, make us better than what they think
And forgive us what they do not know
And do not hold us accountable for what they say
Allah is sufficient for me, there is no god but Him

Arabic text: عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ
Translation: Upon Him I rely and He is the Lord of the Mighty Throne

Arabic text: آمَنَّا بِهِ كُلٌّ مِنْ عِنْدِ رَبِّنَا
Translation: We believe in it, all is from our Lord
And none will remember except those of understanding

Arabic text: رَبَّنَا لاَتُزِغْ قُلُوبَنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنَا
Translation: Our Lord, let not our hearts deviate after You have guided us

Arabic text: وَهَبْ لَنَا مِنْ لَدُنْكَ رَحْمَةً إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْوَهَّابُ
Translation: And grant us from Yourself mercy. Indeed, You are the Bestower
